literal.prompt: Кто из советских руководителей связан с Конституцией СССР, принятой в 1977 году?

literalGroups.primaryGround: The question now asks who is linked to the 1977 USSR Constitution, matching the source's exact historical label. The date, adoption by the USSR Supreme Soviet, and Brezhnev association are explicit at Brezhnev biography L54; the named leaders and their periods are checked against the four cited full variants.
literalGroups.locator: Brezhnev biography L52-L54; Stalin biography L51/L53/L59; Gorbachev biography L44/L50-L51

literalGroups.literal: Верховный Совет СССР принял Конституцию 7 октября 1977 года; Президентская библиотека называет её «Брежневской». Это название связано с Леонидом Брежневым.
literalGroups.primaryGround: The Supreme Soviet of the USSR adopted the Constitution on 7 October 1977, and the official Presidential Library page calls it the ‘Brezhnev Constitution’; it directly ties the label to Leonid Brezhnev.

literalGroups.literal: В 1956 году на XX съезде КПСС доклад Никиты Хрущёва критиковал культ личности и деятельность Сталина.
literalGroups.primaryGround: The claim is the 1956 XX Congress report by Nikita Khrushchev criticizing Stalin's personality cult and activity; the retained official page states this directly.

literalGroups.literal: На XXVII съезде КПСС Горбачёв выступил за экономическое обновление; политику съезда назвали перестройкой, а её лозунгами стали «гласность» и «открытость».
literalGroups.primaryGround: The note distinguishes Gorbachev's 1986 Congress speech for economic renewal from the Congress policy called perestroika and its slogans glasnost and openness; the retained official page states each link.

literalGroups.literal: Иосиф Сталин возглавлял СССР в годы Великой Отечественной войны.
literalGroups.primaryGround: The retained official biography states that Stalin was named chairman of the State Defense Committee, Defence Commissar, and Supreme Commander after the war began.

literalGroups.literal: Октябрьский пленум 1964 года избрал Брежнева Первым секретарём ЦК КПСС после смещения Хрущёва.
literalGroups.primaryGround: The retained official biography states that the October 1964 Central Committee plenary elected Brezhnev First Secretary after removing Khrushchev from all posts.

correctNoteNewFact.fact: In October 1964 the Central Committee plenary removed Khrushchev from all posts and elected Brezhnev First Secretary of the CPSU Central Committee.
correctNoteNewFact.whyAdditional: The prompt and key identify the person associated with the 1977 Constitution; this adds the distinct year and party office that established Brezhnev's leadership before adoption.

absoluteDifficulty.audienceGround: An adult familiar with Soviet history is likely to recognize the named 1977 Constitution and its Brezhnev association. An adult outside the theme can narrow by chronology only if they know the leadership eras; all four choices are real Soviet leaders and none is an absurd option.
absoluteDifficulty.judgment: The frozen medium level is appropriate: the question asks for a specific Soviet-historical association, while the date and plausible leader names permit some contextual narrowing without making the key obvious to an untutored adult.
